business_problem: Sogei needed to build and operate Italy’s Green Pass certificate system in just weeks while securely handling evolving regulations, multi-channel citizen access, and extremely high download volumes.
solution_summary: Sogei used MongoDB Atlas and MongoDB Enterprise Advanced to build and scale Italy’s Green Pass platform under an aggressive public-sector deadline. The system had to securely generate, distribute, and verify COVID certificates for citizens while adapting quickly to changing legal requirements and huge swings in usage. MongoDB’s document model let the team implement schema changes quickly, and prior experience with Atlas on projects like Immuni gave Sogei confidence that the platform could handle the scale. Starting in early May, teams built the services behind certificate generation and delivery, then went live in the middle of June after only 45 days of development. The platform supports multiple citizen access channels, including the Immuni app, the IO government-services app, a dedicated web portal, notifications, and SMS. Atlas helped Sogei manage hundreds of millions of certificate downloads while maintaining a flexible backend for future public-sector services.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Supports the scalable, multi-cloud data platform used to generate, distribute, and access Green Pass certificates.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Enterprise Advanced
solution_components.role: Provided Sogei with an established MongoDB foundation and operational experience before the Green Pass buildout.

data_flow: Certificate and eligibility data are generated through MongoDB-backed services, delivered through apps, web portals, notifications, and SMS, and then accessed by citizens and verifiers across the Green Pass ecosystem.
business_outcome: Sogei delivered a national certificate platform quickly, supported hundreds of millions of downloads across multiple channels, and created a flexible base for future public-sector digital services.
metrics: Sogei delivered the Green Pass platform in 45 days.
Nearly 240 million certificates had been downloaded by early February, roughly a million per day.
Over 20 million people use the apps developed by Sogei, including IO and Immuni.
